item.title: Best Guides for Path of Exile League Keepers of the Flame 3.27
item.description: The newest Path of Exile League — Keepers of the Flame (3.27) — launches today! We've updated the guides on our sister site, PoE Vault, to ensure that Exiles are well-prepared. item.description: Diablo 3 Season 37 starts on December 5 and Blizzard has posted an official preview with what to expect.
